name: Anna-Maja Henriksson - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the implementation and streamlining of EU internal market rules to strengthen the single market
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to make the EU single market work better. It wants fewer and simpler rules for businesses, especially small ones, and faster, more consistent enforcement of existing rules across member states. It also calls for better checks before new laws are made, more digital tools so companies report information only once, and continued strong protection for consumers. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- The report asks for simpler rules, less paperwork and faster enforcement; no law changes yet.
- It affects businesses, especially small firms and start-ups, and consumers across the EU.
- Next, the Commission is asked to act on these ideas with concrete measures and timelines.
